scheduler_overhead_anchor.principle: Per-step Python/dispatcher cost is independent of token-level work. Calibrated from one trace's quietest steps — single anchor, no fit.

_notes.kv_capacity_derivation: Empirical, 2026-05-27: 27250 = max(free_kv_blocks) + first-step allocation = 27192 + 58 observed across 4 vLLM engine traces (swe_c40, swe_c80, swe_c320, terminal_c80). The spec-derived value 27651 (=58 GB / 16 tokens / 131072 bytes) is 1.5% too high — vLLM reserves ~400 blocks for sentinels/scratch. Recorded in profiling/docs/q1-kv-blocks-verification-2026-05-27.md.

util_provenance.history: The original hand-read anchors ('116.6/178 = 0.655 ≈ 0.65' on a step that does not exist in the committed swe_c40 trace, and '16.06/17 = 0.945 ≈ 0.93' whose cited step 17 is a 290 ms outlier and whose T~7200 byte count matches no reconstructed step) are NOT reproducible — removed.
util_provenance.rederivation: Pre-registered deterministic recipe over the four pinned serving-wall traces (gitignored working-set on this host) (recipe text committed BEFORE computing): util_bw = 0.8111 (median over 62 steady-state, bandwidth-dominated, outlier-trimmed decode-only steps; byte-quartile-stable 0.804-0.830), util_flops = 0.5886 (n=7, THIN; submit-wall convention gives >1 on 2 steps under AsyncScheduler — prefer prefill_gemm_util_H100.json), scheduler_overhead = 4.5574 ms (median over 2666 batch-1 decode steps).
util_provenance.values_kept: 0.65 / 0.93 / 5.7 retained. util_bw=0.8111 was wired as a candidate and gated 2026-06-10 (replay-ON gate_scoped_rows vs same-worktree baseline): H100 tpot_cell 14.32→14.99 (+0.67), tpot chat 5.46→6.23 (+0.77), H100x2 tpot_cell 28.75→31.01 (+2.26); TTFT and A100 unmoved → FAIL (±0.3), candidate REJECTED (defit_log_entries/L6-utils.md). 0.93 stays pinned-with-measured-disagreement: it compensates host overhead the decode pricing carries no separate term for (cf. the net-of-sched util 1.25 > 1 diagnostic — util_bw=0.93 and a separate 5.7 ms decode sched term cannot both be honest).
